summary: Segura Cloud Entitlements (CIEM): an inventory of accounts, resources and permissions in AWS, Azure, GCP and Oracle Cloud, cutting rights back to actual use.
value: Excessive and unused cloud permissions are found and cut back.
It shows privilege escalation paths in the cloud.
A stolen cloud account gives an attacker fewer options.
simple: Discovers and keeps an inventory of all accounts, resources, policies and permission changes in AWS, Azure, GCP and Oracle Cloud; analyzes permissions and trims them to match actual usage; shows access paths on a three-dimensional diagram; has reports, alerts and severity settings tailored to company policy. Integrated with Segura PAM. Separate product, purchased in addition to Segura PAM Core; cloud, on premises or hybrid.
classification: The class is CIEM; a separate product bought on top of PAM Core.
